findings.mechanism: The focus nurture and watchpost carriers meet exact settled-soul, return, mutual-acceptance, entry, service, and garden coordinates; the contact changes a uniformly punitive roadblock into a traveler-specific gate.
findings.reader_payoff: The final invitation makes the station's watch capable of recognition and safe passage as well as interception.
findings.containment: The HFT trace is revised but legacy_unbound, and the live alternative that the closing invitation is an independent promise remains explicit.

epistemic.reason: Exact HFT anchors and context coordinates are supplied, while all non-focus branches remain attributed and the traveler-specific inference is qualified.

branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved garden branch is attributed and does not lexicalize the focus.

findings.title: The station adjudicates a binding relation
findings.claim: The station can carry a covenantal checkpoint whose breach becomes binding detention and whose fulfillment becomes reciprocal acceptance and belonging.
findings.mechanism: The focus covenant and preparation carriers meet exact binding, reciprocal-satisfaction, entry, and obedient-belonging coordinates; the contact gives the station two relational directions without selecting either as the sole reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The post becomes legible as a place where a relation is tested and its next passage is determined.
findings.containment: This is qualified HFT contextual evidence; the binding and acceptance branches are unresolved or attributed outside the focus, and parallel-destiny remains a live alternative.

epistemic.reason: Exact HFT anchors and coordinates support the relation, but target morphology and independent lexicon records for most context branches are absent.

findings.title: The station as a threshold of reserved release
findings.claim: As a contained material analogy, the station can be imagined as a reservoir threshold where reserved release descends as scourge or returns as life-bearing growth.
findings.mechanism: The focus cloud and first-rain carriers meet exact pouring, returning-water, and garden-growth coordinates; the contact changes stored punitive consequence into a measured release with two material directions.
findings.reader_payoff: The station's reserve acquires a physical rhythm of holding, release, return, and growth while the judicial reading stays visible.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory cross-domain analogy only. It is never a direct lexical gloss of the focus words, and the unresolved context branches remain attributed.

epistemic.reason: The outlier is explicitly exploratory and its exact focus/context anchors are supplied, but its material composition is surprising and context branches are unresolved.

friction_notes: The packet supplies no selected_context_units and no independent target morphology for the HFT context anchors; all unresolved-root activations therefore remain attributed.

The HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and its packet scope is broader than the declared pericope, so before/after claims are retained as qualified contextual evidence rather than lexical findings.
The unanchored HFT summary claims were reviewed but rejected because their records do not supply the coordinate, independent trigger, and focus return required for activation.
The positive returning-post reading and the punitive station reading coexist; the closing invitation remains a live alternative to reactivating the station.
